message.content:
This vertical rectangular magazine cover features a black and white design with a red border on the left edge. The background consists of numerous parallel black vertical lines. A large, transparent grey word "TEMPO" spans the upper third. Below, several jagged, oscillating lines, resembling seismograph readings, form a vertical silhouette suggestive of a geographical landmass.

Small black text at the top reads: "AKHIR PENGEJARAN LUCAS," "DRAMA TAK SELESA RATNA SARUMPAET," and "LIPUTAN KHUSUS PARA PENJAGA BATIK TULIS." Bold, black capital letters on the lower right state: "BERTIKAI PANGKAI SEHABIS GEMPA." Underneath, smaller text reads: "PENANGANAN LINDU DAN TSUNAMI PALU BERANTAKAN PADA PEKAN PERTAMA. LAPORAN DARI LOKASI KEJADIAN."

At the bottom left, there is a barcode, the number "00033," and "9 770126 427302." To its right, small text includes "8-14 OKTOBER 2018," "RP 45.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0128 - 4273." A small grey and dark red horizontal bar is at the bottom left corner.
